candidates.rationale: Paul speaks of building carefully on a foundation others will use, warning that each builder's work will be tested and must be of quality.
Nehemiah rallies people to rebuild Jerusalem's walls, recognizing the collective dependence on shared infrastructure and the need for careful, coordinated work.
Jesus teaches that those entrusted with much are held to a higher standard of responsibility, applicable to those maintaining critical systems.
This passage instructs leaders to know the state of their flocks and be diligent, as riches and positions of responsibility do not last forever without careful stewardship.
God appoints skilled craftsmen filled with wisdom and ability to build the tabernacle, emphasizing the importance of competence and care in work others will depend upon.
